summary: MaintUserStudent manages student user accounts in the HSPnet system, providing a web-based workflow for creating, updating, enabling/disabling, supporting, and securing student login credentials. Special handling is implemented for accounts using Single Sign-On (SSO), and rigorous validation and messaging are employed for account operations.
purpose: To facilitate the administration of student user accounts, including creation, modification, password management, SSO integration, and user support commentary. The screen enables system administrators and authorized users to safely manage student access and ensure compliance with security and business rules.

fields.name: UserName
fields.validation: RequiredFieldValidator1; must be unique for add; editable if UserId == 0 or administrator

fields.name: NewPassword
validation: pwdStrength control: min length, numeric, symbol, case requirements

workflows.name: Create Student User
steps: Generate a new random password (12 chars)
If SSO enabled, UserId = Users.UserAddStudent(..., IssueEmail = false); else, IssueEmail may be true.
Add warning/message depending on SSOUPN presence.
If IssueEmail, send email to user with credentials.
On success, show Save button and enable Change Password.

workflows.name: Update Student User
steps: If SSO enabled and EntityID present, IssueEmail is false; update student user.
Add warning/message depending on SSOUPN presence.
If SSO not enabled, update student user and optionally issue email.
If account was disabled and is now enabled, offer password reset workflow.

workflows.name: Change Password
steps: Save new password (Users.UserSetPassword); send email if enabled.
Show warning/message depending on email success.

workflows.name: User Support Comment
steps: Save support comment; update support comment display and icon.

business_rules: User names must be unique for new accounts.
Email address is required and must match validation regex.
New passwords must be minimum 12 characters, contain upper/lower case, symbols, and digits.
SSO-enabled accounts do not send user credentials by email and hide issue email controls.
Disabled student users cannot change password until enabled.
Support comments only editable by system administrator and visible for non-zero user IDs.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator on UserName, Email, NewPassword, ConfirmPassword.
Panel validation summaries for detail and password groups.
conditions: If SSO.EntityID != null, treat as SSO-enabled.
If account disabled, hide Change Password button.
If IssueEmail checkbox is visible and checked, send creation email.
If SSOUPN is present or missing, display corresponding warning.
system_behavior: Page_Render processes error and warning panels for user feedback.
Page_Load sets up session, loads user and student info, configures visibility.
Controls for warnings and errors are always visible using extender.
Panels and popups manage workflow visibility for change password and user support.
dependencies: Resources: for all text, error messages, tooltips, labels.
Users: for create, update, set password, support comment.
Programs, Departments, SsoSettingsActions: for SSO configuration.
exceptions: If duplicate user detected, show error message.
If SSO enabled, hide IssueEmail controls and section.
If email sending fails on creation or password set, add warning or error.
If input validation fails, prevent save/change.
content_gaps: Resource string values are referenced rather than inlined; exact UI text and some error messages not directly available.
Business logic for password and email templates may depend on external template definitions not provided.
Some field max length validations are inferred but not explicitly stated in code.
